id: ISS-0950
title: "Catalog service endpoint_url is not URL-validated at registration/publish time (decision 0027 gap)"
discovered_by: SECURITY-REVIEWER
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0917-20261001 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T14:06:29Z"
severity: MINOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by SECURITY-REVIEWER in WF03-ISS0917-20261001. POST /service-catalog and publish do no
  UrlValidator check on endpoint_url; the only control is the dispatch-time INV-9 gate in
  ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport/3. ISS-0917's fix makes catalog endpoints reachable by the
  dispatcher for the first time, so add fast-feedback syntactic validation (https scheme, host not
  private/loopback literal) at register/publish time in Letflow.ServiceCatalog /
  Routers.AdminServices. Defense in depth; dispatch gate stays binding. Severity MINOR (hardening).
  Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via CODE-DESIGNER).
affected_files:
  - lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex
  - lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex
queue_ref: Q-921  # queue issue_ref ISS-0921 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0950
github_ref: GH-2095
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 4b TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (hard gate). Validate the regression tests for ISS-0950 (branch feature/WF03-ISS0950-20261001; files: test/letflow/service_catalog/endpoint_url_validation_test.exs, test/support/iss0950_endpoint_url_fixtures.ex, test/specs/ISS-0950.md, appended tests in test/letflow/webhooks/url_validator_test.exs, test/letflow/routers/admin_services_test.exs, test/letflow/routers/admin_services_publish_retire_test.exs). Check: every row of the design test matrix (lib/letflow/design/iss0950-catalog-endpoint-url-register-validation.md) has a runnable, non-vacuous test; no skips/excludes; fixtures isolated and self-sufficient; assertions check real outcomes (422 body shape, changeset error key/validation tag, DB row not changed/archived on rejected publish), not just 'no crash'. MANDATORY per WF-03 doc: INDEPENDENTLY APPLY at least TWO of TEST-DESIGNER's reported mutants (suggested m4 get_change-instead-of-get_field, m7 skip-when-key-absent, and one of m1/m3) in a THROWAWAY git worktree of the branch (outside the repo; git worktree add ... HEAD), run the 4 test files there, and reproduce the reported counts (m4 68/70, m7 69/70, m1 59/70, m3 64/70); also probe one mutant of your own choosing not in their list (e.g. publish rolls back archive insert removed, or template path-placeholder wrongly rejected). Check the U-NODNS(b) trace test is non-vacuous (positive control). Remove worktrees afterwards and verify git worktree list shows only the main checkout and git status --porcelain lib/ test/ is unchanged. Machine is shared: no full suite; scoped runs only. Never git checkout/reset in the main checkout. Complete PASS/FAIL per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md (write the result block yourself). Do not commit.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix coverage verified row by row
At least two reported mutants independently re-applied with reproduced counts quoted, plus one own mutant
Worktrees removed; main checkout lib/ and test/ unchanged

result.summary: Read the design matrix, ISS-0950.md spec and all five test files directly. Matrix coverage is complete and non-skipped except one row that is vacuous: R-LEN. All 23 REJECT and 10 ACCEPT rows are exercised at E/R/P/HTTP via a shared fixture; P-SAME-URL, P-ROLLBACK, R-NO-ROW, R-MISSING (register+publish), P-ABSENT a/b, UNTOUCHED-PATHS, U-SCHEME/BLOCKLIST/PARITY/NODNS(a)(b) present; no @tag skip/TODO; fixtures use unique ids with on_exit cleanup; assertions check 422 detail, absence of URL/'endpoint_url' in body, changeset message + validation tag, and DB row/version-count unchanged. U-NODNS(b) is non-vacuous (separate tracer + positive control). INDEPENDENT MUTANTS in throwaway worktree of d4c506a0 (outside repo; deps/_build copied), 4 test files, baseline 'Result: 70 passed': m4 get_change instead of get_field -> 68/70 (P-SAME-URL, P-ABSENT(b) fail) REPRODUCED; m7 skip when key absent from params -> 69/70 (only P-ABSENT(b)) REPRODUCED; m1 accept http -> 59/70, 11 failed REPRODUCED. Own mutants: own1 brace anywhere in URL rejected (path-placeholder wrongly rejected) -> 64/70, 6 ACCEPT-row/placeholder tests fail (killed); own3 silent default_resolver call inside validate_syntactic (result ignored) -> 69/70, only U-NODNS(b) fails (killed, confirms trace test is live); own2 remove the 'field already has an :endpoint_url error' de-duplication clause in validate_endpoint_url -> 70/70 passed, i.e. SURVIVED. Cause: the R-LEN test (endpoint_url_validation_test.exs ~L181-190) uses 'https://example.test/' + 'a' padding, a URL that is valid under check_endpoint_url, so the new step would add no second error even without the dedup branch; the test cannot distinguish dedup from no-dedup and design D5(b) / matrix R-LEN is effectively unasserted. Cleanup: worktree removed + pruned, git worktree list shows only the main checkout; git status --porcelain lib/ test/ is empty (0 lines); main checkout never modified (git checkout only ever ran inside the throwaway worktree).

issues.description: R-LEN is vacuous: test 'R-LEN: an over-length URL yields exactly ONE :endpoint_url error' in test/letflow/service_catalog/endpoint_url_validation_test.exs uses an over-length URL that is otherwise valid, so deleting the Keyword.has_key?(changeset.errors, :endpoint_url) clause from Entry.validate_endpoint_url/1 leaves all 70 tests green (measured 70/70). Fix: make the over-length URL ALSO statically bad (e.g. 'http://example.test/' padded to 2049 chars, or 'https://127.0.0.1/' padded) and assert exactly one error with validation == :length (and no :endpoint_url_not_allowed). Optionally mirror on publish/3. Re-verify by removing the dedup clause in a throwaway worktree: the new test must fail.

result.next_action: Rework TEST-DESIGNER (iteration 1 of 3): strengthen R-LEN as described so the dedup-removal mutant is killed; no other changes required. Then re-gate 4b.
